title: Plan links, schemaVersion 1
description: Stored at .opencode/workplan/<id>.links.json (spec 06 X5, contracts §26): how this plan relates to other plans in the same root. Parent-owned, outside the state manifest; the portfolio view built from all of them is read-only and advisory. Written whole by workplan_update.planLinks.

relation.description: blocks: the other plan waits for this one; blockedBy: this plan waits for the other; related: no order.
